rows.surface: [atha mantrākṣaranyāsaḥ oṃ ghṛśīrṣaṇi, oṃ ṇiḥ mukhe, oṃ sū kaṇṭhe, oṃ ryyaḥ hṛdaye, oṃ ākukṣau, oṃ di liṅge, oṃ tyaḥ pādayoḥ, itthaṃ nyāsānkṛtvā dhyāyet || ]
